what_it_is: contribution 3's key datum: the trained decay distribution and per-layer half-lives of the RWKV-7 recurrence, through forward hooks on the s9500 endpoint. Lemma 1 is proved from the parameterization; this measures the horizon the parameterization PREDICTS.
diagnosis: NOT a spec or command defect. The same spec (79fe954a, 1 GPU) is what the efficiency probe used, and that succeeded on its third attempt; the failure mode here is job_fail_reserving, which is the scheduler assigning a node and being unable to reserve it. The cause is this program's OWN matrix holding 72+ GPUs: the arm matrix is the thing competing with the survey.
not_a_blind_retry_rationale: each attempt is a NEW submission of a body that has been validated, against a transient family of failure with a terminal status -- not a retry after an UNKNOWN outcome, which is the case that must never be retried.
plan: retry when the matrix drains. Its last arm is projected to finish near 10:20 UTC, and the survey needs one card.
